admission.justification: No member alone delivers the promise: agent-alone navigation without the display gate can acknowledge a missing screen, the gate without truthful deadline naming can wait silently, and naming without navigation reaches nothing. Together they promise the selected chat appears or its problem is named.

guarantee: The Operations document chat settles the selected document's live agent truthfully: navigation reaches the agent in its workspace by message-first moves that never reload the frame, shown is reported only for that agent's displayed screen — never for another agent — and a silent frame ends in the agent-naming problem state with at most one fallback load when the frame does not already name the target. A pending or failed request retains the previous screen; it never ends in an endless loading.
title: The selected document's agent chat appears, or the pane names its problem
